correctness.rationale: For every D,v,alpha>0, the coupled stationary reflected Fokker-Planck equations reduce by exact integration to rho third order and D^2 rho''=v^2 rho at both endpoints. The unique normalized positive solution has rho(L)L=F(L). Independent coordinate generators tensorize exactly. The wall-contact force and dV_i=V dlog L_i give a globally exact work one-form. Strict theta derivative negativity implies strict log-length convexity. Controlled small- and large-length expansions prove the sharp distortion laws. Coercivity and second-variation plus stationary first-order balance prove the symmetry-breaking stiffness threshold and weak-K limit. Standalone analytic/numeric consistency program check.py passed 1670 deterministic tests, not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The exact one-dimensional telegraph density, 1D pressure and AOUP approximate multidimensional equation of state are explicitly prior. The assessed statement instead proves exactness for a Cartesian product of telegraph components in arbitrary dimension and derives a strict global fixed-volume majorization landscape, an exact shape-work primitive, an unbounded aspect law, and a sharp Hookean shape-stiffness instability. Primary full article and supplemental equations and two relevant earlier full mathematical articles were inspected. No inspected work states this complete conclusion; priority remains qualified because tensorization of prior pressure may be seen as implicit.
residual_risks: The entire conclusion is a mathematically short tensorized extension of a known exact 1D pressure law; specialists may classify it as an implicit corollary rather than a distinct priority claim.
Earlier active-membrane literature not completely exhausted; strong physical analogues of shape instability exist in other models.
Ideal point-particle extreme aspect ratios and quasistatic wall-force closure may be physically regularized.

value.rationale: At strictly fixed volume the source gas supplies positive mechanical work for every nontrivial log-majorizing shape deformation whereas a passive ideal gas supplies none; this establishes a global, exact anti-isoperimetric principle, an experimentally interpretable shape-force restoring threshold K_c, existence of two symmetry-broken optimal shapes below threshold and sharp K^{-1} divergence of the logarithmic aspect ratio at weak stiffness. These quantitative features are motivated by finite-box active gas mechanics and not arbitrary parameter evaluation.
